cascadeInspection: Codex independently inspected all 12 fresh matrix states at commit 148d05aecc0f40c29a1c7d4ce1d1570710b8f222. The first review found a real tablet/full-page state defect: the pointer-preview close handler cleared its transient flag before deciding whether to close, and the capture browser briefly reported a 1x1 viewport. The controller now closes only a genuinely transient hover preview, ignores non-meaningful 1x1 viewport transitions, and uses the public --ren-z-sticky token for overlay layering. Final desktop light/dark has one aligned trigger and one chevron, three columns x four aligned icon/title/description destinations, and a narrower five-link contrast rail. The 834px tablet state uses two readable columns, a third group below, visible descriptions, and a stacked full-width contrast rail; its 1600px capture height contains the complete panel without full-page resize artifacts. Mobile uses one in-flow tree, start-aligned icon/title rows, hidden descriptions, stacked rail and CTA actions, and no overflow. JS-disabled native disclosure remains usable. Classless details/summary chrome is neutralized, inline SVGs are sized by ren-icon, no numeric z-index or hardcoded color literals remain, and light/dark token surfaces are coherent. Hover-open and click-open desktop PNGs are pixel-identical (ImageMagick AE = 0). Every state reports 12 destinations, 12 descriptions, 12 icons, 3 groups, 1 chevron, 1 rail, 1 rail heading, and 5 rail links.
